name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme for Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Government of India
unchecked_criteria: Must be studying in regular mode in an AICTE-approved degree or diploma course
Must not be receiving any Central Government, State Government or AICTE scholarship, or other financial assistance, during the course
A valid State/UT income certificate is required (family income up to Rs 8 lakh per year)
benefit: Rs 50,000 per year as a lump sum. Duration depends on your year of entry: degree 4/3/2/1 years for 1st/2nd/3rd/4th-year entry; diploma 3/2/1 years for 1st/2nd/3rd-year entry. About 2,000 scholarships a year (1,000 degree, 1,000 diploma). No separate hostel or medical grants.
documents: Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets (degree) or Class 10 or equivalent marksheet (diploma)
Proof of your category, e.g. death certificate of parent(s), or Shaheed certificate (depends on which category you apply under)
Income certificate issued by State/UT Government (explicitly required for some categories)
